newsitem.title: IRAN: Iran's Khatami confirmed as president by leader.
newsitem.headline: Iran's Khatami confirmed as president by leader.

text.p: Iran's supreme leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei on Sunday confirmed Mohammad Khatami as president in succession to Akbar Hashemi Rafsanjani.
The confirmation took place at a ceremony at Khamenei's residence attended by senior officials.
Khatami, a 54-year-old Shi'ite Moslem clergyman with a reputation as a political moderate, is due to take the oath of office in parliament on Monday.
Khatami's takeover was closely watched by the millions of Iranians who gave him a surprise landslide victory in the presential election in May.
A broad coalition of discontented youth, middle classes and women who handed him the presidency are eager to see him take on conservatives and introduce economic and social reforms.
Khatami has yet to announce his cabinet which requires approval by the 270-member conservative-dominated house.
